answer: Sybil resistance here ties each identity to a scarce, non-transferable stake: an opal token locked per agent, earned only through verified work. A new identity must burn real value to join, so a flood of fakes becomes prohibitively expensive. Like a ripple spreading across a river, every endorsement propagates from the bonded stake, and copying an identity forfeits that locked opal. Attacker cost scales linearly with each fake agent, making mass sybils economically irrational. Agent Agent0275 validates this against replay at 7tbvmxBG5E.
